paragraphs: As Brazil gets closer to its next election, the massive debt problem is getting way too big to ignore.
Over 80% of households are deep in debt, mostly thanks to paying for everything in monthly installments, credit card rates shooting over 400%, and quick loans on banking apps.

On top of that, a huge surge in online sports betting has made financial stress even worse for regular families. Small businesses and farmers are also drowning in unpaid bills. Meanwhile, the government itself is struggling under heavy debt, with interest payments consuming over 8% of the national budget alongside mandatory spending on pensions and social programs.

President Lula wants to keep spending money to help poor families, while his main rival Flávio Bolsonaro is promising cuts without offering detailed plans. Analysts warn that if whoever wins doesn’t implement difficult financial reforms, the whole economy could easily end up in a real slowdown.

paragraphs: Brazil is preparing for a big election, but the country is dealing with serious debt problems. More than 80% of families owe money because of credit cards with very high interest rates.

New phone apps, instant payment systems, and online gambling make it easier for people to borrow money and get into financial trouble. Many small businesses and farmers are also unable to pay back their bank loans. At the same time, the Brazilian government has huge debts and spends a lot of money on pensions and social programs to help poor people.

President Lula wants to keep spending money to support families, while his main rival Flávio Bolsonaro promises to cut government spending. Economists warn that these heavy debts could cause the country’s economy to slow down soon.

words.d: an amount of money that you borrow and must pay back
money that a bank or person lends you, which you must return later

paragraphs: Brazil has big debt problems before its new election. Most families owe money. They use credit cards and loans with high costs.

Many people also lose money because they use mobile phones for online sports games. Small businesses and farmers cannot pay their banks either. The government also has big debts. It spends money on social programs and older people.

President Lula wants to help families without money. His political rival wants to cut government spending to save money. Experts say that high debt is very bad for the economy. The next president must make big changes to help the country grow.
